difference_from_old_reset: Old posterior_history_diagnostic held models fixed and erased recurrent history. This experiment actually trains initial observation assimilation and downstream transition networks from intermediate public windows.

arms.full: Original complete trajectories and unmodified objective.
arms.history_mix: Same sampled episodes; exactly half full, half uniformly selected nonterminal intermediate starts; matched cropped losses. Prefill only earlier public observations/actions without gradients, then train current observation update and subsequent transitions.
arms.cold_mix: Identical sample IDs/crops/targets/normalization to history_mix. Replace intermediate recurrent prior with zeros and train current observation update and subsequent transitions.

training.initialization: Identical original fixed seed initialization, no finetuning
training.checkpoint: Only step1500 for comparison; no selection
training.loss: Original current + .5*(prior+multi3+terminal_from_relative_h2+outcome), masks exclude padding; short crops lack terminal terms. history_mix controls all crop-content/exposure changes.
training.frozen_encoder_and_RGBD: Original two seeds frozen encoder, coarse32+16 geometry; original training-only normalization unchanged

input_scope: Each intermediate start uses its original causal four-control-frame dual-camera window including preceding frames and current robot states. No future frame or GT label/state is an initializer. Cached visible-region registry can carry earlier public history; only recurrent prior is reset, not a claim of memoryless single-frame input. New independent roots have naturally fresh registry.

evaluation.development: All original full episodes plus every nonterminal intermediate origin; cold initial Held/In/drawer, subsequent observed and free1..5, non-target stable In and prior-correct denominator. Development has been reused historically; not a pristine test.
evaluation.exploratory: Prior relation_generalization four families only exploratory, never training; normal and externally perturbed branches separate.
evaluation.fresh_validation_trigger: Both cold_mix seeds improve development initial positive In recall >=20 percentage points vs full, and initial joint accuracy does not decline. If true run a small new independent normal-branch known4/novel4 matched cohort; no order-generalization claim without it.
evaluation.fresh_scope: 24 episodes:4 new layout families A2/B2 x3 cyclic H/T pairs xknown4/novel4, nominal branch only; no new skill. Deterministic proposals and prior geometry exclusion; no outcome/model replacement.

controls: World-model input no GT; existing fixed low-level controller uses GT assistance, explicitly authorized and unchanged.
